items.dod: bash tool/gate.sh --fast prints a stage line for tool-tests and runs every tool/test/*.test.mjs
a deliberately failing test under tool/test/ turns the gate red (evidence/U-001/red.log), removing it turns it green
items.command: cat > tool/test/zz-fails.test.mjs (prints FAIL and exits 1); bash tool/gate.sh --fast; rm tool/test/zz-fails.test.mjs; bash tool/gate.sh --fast
